name: White Night
source:
In a world shaped entirely by cats, feline civilizations mirror our own. Lyosha, a young caracal, journeys through a society where identity is shaped by “nicknames” bestowed by others.

[From [url=https://tess-72.itch.io/white-night]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个完全由猫塑造的世界中，猫科动物的文明反映了我们自己的文明。年轻的野猫Lyosha经历了一个身份由他人赋予的“昵称”塑造的社会。

[来自[url=https://tess-72.itch.io/white-night]Itch.io[/url]]
